summary: Multiplayer auto-join retry loop. Gated on an auto-join enabled byte at (*this + 0xC6); selects championship mode (dword_7D0410 clamped against two alternate sources), runs a QPC-timed retry loop that polls session state. On ready state (SessionStateCheck == 3) it builds a session descriptor, requests a unique ID, writes path/session config, resets every vehicle entry with SessionStateTransition(-1, 0), zeroes the vehicle count, rebuilds the active-vehicle pointer array and dispatches client team-select. On timeout or unrecoverable state it logs and aborts. Returns 1 on successful join, 0 otherwise.
